enchantments.tooltip: Returning: This missile will return to you.
+10 Enhancement Bonus: +10 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Aligned: This weapon transmutes into a form that is able to bypass any alignment based Damage Reduction. (Chaotic, Good, Evil, Lawful)
Knee Cracker: On Hit: 15% chance to slow 25% (No Save) for 5 sec (non-bosses only).

Thunderbane: This weapon was crafted in the great Thunderforge before the Dragons came. Against constructs and the undead, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +8 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 7 to 42 points of damage against the foes.
Forged Lightning: On Hit: 2% Chance to do 300 to 500 damage in a blast radius.
